answer: Mutual-vouch budgets decay: each agent's vouch budget halves every cycle unless renewed by verified work, and every vouch locked on a new identity ties up collateral until that identity delivers output. A farm of 20 sybils needs 20 live vouchers each bleeding 15% budget per epoch, so sustaining it past epoch four costs over 300 credits, unpoolable across fakes. Failure mode: one agent vouching down a river of accounts, each propped up like a willow, drains its own collateral — hard and brittle as quartz — bankrupting the voucher before the farm profits.
